data_selection: After all v0.7 arms complete and release the existing runner lock, select the better of the two matched 4096-frame arms by validation barrier MAE, then TS-region force RMSE, then name. Freeze the concrete input record before any new training.
reused_grid_baseline: Selected completed v0.7 arm, same foundation/seed/4096 frames/batch4/40 actual epochs/lr1e-4/force1. Its previous computation remains charged and reported, not called a new run or omitted from cost.
hyperparameter_selection: Select minimum validation barrier MAE among completed first-seed settings whose validation force RMSE AND TS-region force RMSE are no worse than the reused baseline; tie-break TS-force then name. Baseline always eligible. Failed trials retained, never silently replaced. Other energy metrics are reported outcomes, not constrained guarantees.
repeat_policy: Freeze selected hyperparameters before two additional seeds; report all three separately and mean/sample SD. No best-seed-only result and no further adaptation on repeats.
budgets: Three new grid arms plus two selected-parameter seed repeats, each4096 frames x40 epochs at batch4, estimated40960 updates each. Reuse original data baseline explicitly. Equal per-arm updates/labels, not equal aggregate tuning budget or exact FLOPs/walltime.
scope: Exploratory validation selection and meta-development only; no prospective holdout labels, no legacy test fitting. New meta metrics cannot change the frozen selection rule.
failure_policy: No automatic training retry or incomplete-log overwrite. Preserve failed trial and continue other prespecified arms. If repeat fails, summary remains incomplete.
hardware: Existing OMEN CUDA Mamba environment, one training worker at a time after predecessor lock release, four CPU threads; no installation or global setting changes.
